<!-- Requesting a brand-new tool? This project aims for a focused set of broadly useful tools rather than the biggest possible collection, so new tools are added when there's clear, widespread demand. See https://github.com/codysechelski/codys-dev-tools-two#philosophy -->

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of what you're trying to do that the app doesn't currently support.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you'd want the tool/feature to do.

**Who would use this, and how often?**
For a new tool especially: what kind of developers would reach for it, and is it an everyday task or an occasional one?

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other approaches or workarounds you've thought about.

**Additional context**
Mockups, examples from other tools, links, etc.
